title: Skeleton Pianist and Candle Woman
description: A skeletal figure in a tuxedo plays a bright red grand piano on the left, surrounded by swirling black decorative lines with moths and stars. On the right, a woman in a blue off-shoulder gown sits on a blue chaise lounge holding a lit candle, with a large arched window behind her showing a cracked, barren landscape at sunset and black flowers at its base. Golden rings are scattered on the floor in the foreground.
prompt: A skeletal figure wearing a tuxedo plays a vibrant red grand piano on the left side, surrounded by ornate swirling black lines, moths, stars and crosses. On the right a beautiful woman in a flowing blue off-shoulder gown sits barefoot on a blue velvet chaise lounge holding up a lit candle that sparks. Behind her is a tall arched window revealing a cracked barren landscape with dead trees under a pink and orange sunset. Black flowers sit below the window and golden rings are scattered across the dark floor, dramatic gothic surreal scene with high contrast and detailed linework.
